cells.text: Interrupts and exceptions are a form of control transfer operation. They are used to call special system-

cells.text: descriptor table, or IDT. In legacy real mode, the IDT contains an array of 4-byte far pointers to

cells.glyphEvidence: not-extracted: source is Unicode word boxes

cells.glyphEvidence: not-extracted: source is Unicode word boxes
